eligibility.quote: The difference is enough to cause the `base->tool0` transform to be off by as much as 3 degrees wrt to the values reported by the robot.

failed_conditions.quote: The `link_t-tool0` transform defining the orientation of the `tool0` frame currently specifies only a rotation over Z of `-pi`, but it uses the value `3.1416` for it ([here](https://github.com/ros-industrial/motoman/blob/e2384f02d926da5b9716fdf915783af31962138c/motoman_sia20d_support/urdf/sia20d_macro.xacro#L188)).

loudness.quote: The difference is enough to cause the `base->tool0` transform to be off by as much as 3 degrees wrt to the values reported by the robot.

notes: Verified via gh api: issue #106 title 'sia20: incorrect T->tool0 rotation (pi != 3.1416)' and body (both quotes above verbatim), the comments ('Similar to #102.', 'The SIA10F (and I assume the D) has the same problem', 'SIA10D urdf doesn't have this problem', 'Fixed in 9bf25ea.'), and the merge commit 9bf25ea message ('sia20: don't round PI in joint_t-tool0 transform. Fix #106. Leads to incorrect 'base->tool0' transform orientations.') touching the two macro xacro files. Eligible PAIR at step 6 agreed: a wrong frame definition value in robot_description crosses from the support package into the consumer that computes base->tool0; the consumer is inferred (robot_state_publisher is named nowhere in the source), which the spec rightly flags with low confidence. Class frame_mismatch agreed as the best fit (the tool0 frame's orientation definition disagrees with the robot's reported tool frame); 'other' would be the alternative since the mismatch is numeric precision rather than frame identity. Silent at run agreed: URDF loads cleanly; the discrepancy was seen only by comparing against the robot. Resolution 'recommended' agreed: fixed and closed, but no post-fix comparison of base->tool0 against the robot is shown. (The spec's own caveat stands: 3.1416 vs pi is ~7.3e-6 rad, which does not by itself explain a 3-degree discrepancy; the reporter's figure is recorded verbatim.)
